18-collapsible-tree-search.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol palette and count badges on collapsed nodes show real design intent, but the tree occupies only the top half of the viewport leaving a large dead zone, and typographic hierarchy is modest with no visual weight differentiation between node labels and ranks.
18-collapsible-tree-search.encoding_integrity_note: Tree layout with no quantitative axes sidesteps most honesty checks; circle size encodes categorical state (not magnitude), colors are nominal, SVG dimensions are data-driven via d3.extent/d3.max, but the join key `d.data.name + d.depth` uses string concatenation that could silently collide for nodes sharing a name-prefix across depths.
18-collapsible-tree-search.stress_test_note: No .interrupt() calls before new transitions; the container <g> runs a separate 400ms transition while nodes run 500ms, so rapid node clicks or expand-all during animation can queue or visually misalign transitions; all other checks pass (search is debounced 200ms, pointer events unify mouse/touch, no zoom/brush stale scale, no cross-view dispatch loop).
